summary: Payment-link follow-ups from Workshop ewatrade/assistant/conversations v2 (revision 378e5ca2), family 18 scenes bk-link-state and bk-link-batch. businessBanking.linkCandidates items gain an additive latestLink summary: the Order's newest link state (active, expired or closed), amount, expiry and counts of customer payment reports waiting for review, confirmed or marked not received.
